name: Tobias Tanglefur
dialog: Welcome, friend! Browse a while.
I've set aside something just for you.
homeSpecialty: Discounted cards drawn from the player's Dreamcaller signature tide.

name: Amunet, the Tomb-Keeper
dialog: The sands remember all dreams.
Choose, and I shall show you another.
homeSpecialty: Restock the dreamsign choices once for free.

name: Sigrún
dialog: The frost reveals what is hidden.
Your path is clearer than most.
homeSpecialty: Always a choice (never a single random dreamsign), more choices, tailored to the deck.

name: Durgan Forgehammer
dialog: Stoke the forge — let's reshape it.
Any card, any temper you like.
homeSpecialty: Pick any card and any applicable transfiguration.

name: Deacon Holt
dialog: We endure together, don't we?
Pick one, and I'll make another.

name: Master Takeshi
dialog: Let go of what weighs you down.
A cleaner blade cuts truer.
homeSpecialty: Remove up to 3 cards or banes for free.

name: Aldric, the Seer
dialog: I have foreseen your arrival.
Great fortune awaits the worthy.
homeSpecialty: Bigger rewards, curated to the deck.

name: Maddox
dialog: Out here, every deal's a gamble.
Two offers. Pick your poison.

name: Gravok
dialog: Fortune favors the bold, traveler.
No fee tonight. Big stakes, though.

name: "Layaway"
dialog: Pay later, collect sooner. Deal?
Time's just another currency, choom.
